name: octarine
title: Octarine
description: Search your Octarine workspaces from Raycast
author: aerz

preferences.name: workspaceRoots
preferences.title: Workspace paths
preferences.description: Paths to Octarine workspaces or folders containing them, separated by commas.

preferences.name: excludedWorkspaces
preferences.title: Workspaces to exclude
preferences.description: Workspace names Raycast should skip, separated by commas.

preferences.name: excludedFoldersInWorkspaces
preferences.title: Folders to exclude
preferences.description: Folder names to exclude from note and attachment results across all workspaces, separated by commas.

arguments.name: workspace
arguments.description: Specify the workspace name to open it directly

preferences.name: showWorkspaceNoteCount
preferences.title: Search results
preferences.description: Adds a note count to each workspace section title.
preferences.label: Show a note count in each workspace section

preferences.name: showPinnedNotesFirst
preferences.description: Moves pinned notes to the top of results in each workspace.
preferences.label: Show pinned notes first

preferences.name: searchContent
preferences.description: Searches note content alongside note titles and file paths.
preferences.label: Include note content by default

preferences.name: previewNotesByDefault
preferences.description: Shows the selected note beside the results list when Search Notes opens.
preferences.label: Show a note preview by default

preferences.name: showWorkspaceAttachmentCount
preferences.title: Attachment results
preferences.description: Adds an attachment count to each workspace section title.
preferences.label: Show an attachment count in each workspace section

preferences.name: flattenWorkspaceSections
preferences.description: Applies when All Extensions is selected.
preferences.label: Show attachments in one list

preferences.name: listViewByDefault
preferences.description: Opens Search Attachments in List view instead of Grid.
preferences.label: Show attachments in a list by default

preferences.name: excludeFileExtensions
preferences.title: File extensions to exclude
preferences.description: Extensions to omit from results, separated by commas. A leading dot is optional.

commands.name: open-daily-desk-note
commands.title: Open Daily Desk Note
commands.description: Find and open Daily Desk notes by date

preferences.name: defaultWorkspace
preferences.title: Default workspace
preferences.description: Enter a workspace name to select when the command opens. Leave blank to show notes from all workspaces.

preferences.name: showFilename
preferences.title: Daily note titles
preferences.label: Use the file name as the result title
preferences.description: Shows the file name without its extension, such as 2023-02-18. The formatted date or week label appears as the subtitle.

preferences.name: useLastWorkspace
preferences.title: Date suggestions
preferences.label: Use the last workspace for date suggestions
preferences.description: When you search all workspaces, date suggestions use the workspace where you last opened a note.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
